title: Hudson x David weekly
notes_markdown:
### Fundraising narrative

- Lead with the change: research thinking moved into AI chats, and nobody keeps that history usefully (Marcus's favourite line)
- Then the evidence: Berkeley conversations (Elena, Priya, Ben) — quotes, not stats
- Ask: pre-seed SAFE; target $400k; post-money cap TBD with Surplus legal
- Don't send a deck before pilots; Marcus wants weekly users first

### Demo night draft (due to Lena Oct 1)

- 4 min: problem (30s) → Priya-style story (60s) → live trail demo (90s) → ask (30s) → buffer
- Risk: live demo on house Wi-Fi; record a backup video

### Calendar crunch

- David: UIST talk dry run Sun Oct 4, flies Oct 5, talk Oct 7, back Oct 8
- Pilot sessions: Priya Oct 9, pilot B (Daniel Osei, CMU postdoc, via Priya's referral list) Oct 13
- Marcus follow-up Oct 14
- VT travel-funding request due this week (David)

### Action items

- [ ] Hudson — 1-page narrative v2 + SAFE terms summary
- [ ] David — demo night bullet draft by Sep 30
- [ ] David — submit VT travel-funding request (Grace Kim) by Thu Sep 24
- [ ] Hudson — book Daniel Osei for Oct 13
